candidates.title: Can a magistrate summon you for extortion without evidence? Patna HC answers
candidates.excerpt: Recently, the Patna high court dismissed a criminal case citing insufficient evidence to support the extortion claims. The court highlighted that the allegations did not fulfill the legal criteria set by the Indian Penal Code. Moreover, the accused was absent during the incidents detailed in the complaint, pointing out misuse of the legal system for personal vendettas. This ruling emphasized the importance of adhering to due process in criminal matters.

candidates.excerpt: People in the know say while the aviation ministry “keeps the aircraft accident investigating agency at an arm’s length and does not interfere in its working in any way,” it is taking steps to strengthen the AAIB. The bureau's lab has been recently upgraded and it now has the capability to download cockpit voice recorder and digital flight data recorder (black box) to know the conversation in the flight deck and the flight parameters till before an event being investigated.
